dataset.review: Agent visual review and translations, not independent human/native-speaker review; incomplete known-positive labels.

training.weighting: equal family/translation mass and per-query balanced classes

uncertainty.method: Descriptive paired source-component bootstrap, 10000 draws; translations and same-project intents resampled together; not used for selection

paired_latency.method: 12 seeded fixed queries, real production requests, paired alternating mode order; no concurrent full evaluation or OCR jobs; brief verification/file reads and host background are not controlled. No external candidate trace capture or per-request resource sampler; the model path still computes its required candidate features.

verification.encoding_change: Explicit UTF-8 manifest read only; model unchanged; all 357 production candidates and rankings verified against baseline/replay.

failures.diagnosis: Visually reviewed targets remain in the pool. Arabic snowboarder is visual rank 37, hybrid 38, union 72, hybrid50 49. Zero-OCR target has no semantic interaction; semantically retrieved low-visual candidates with noisy OCR can overtake it. KDE second positive moves 2 to 3 because a generic Run/Debug Configurations screenshot with lexical rank 1 but gated lexical evidence 0 moves 11 to 2. Pizza platter moves 6 to 7. Pointwise features are not constrained by the baseline evidence gates.
failures.implemented: hybrid50 scope preserves baseline top-50 membership for every query; validation recall guards reject observed overall/language/kind losses; hybrid stays default.
failures.remaining: The validation-selected union still loses one fresh-test photo despite no overall recall loss. Do not switch finalists or retune on this test. Review new train-only hard negatives and test evidence-gated rank/interaction features in a separately frozen study.

failures.diagnosis: Indexing retained the image as degraded after Tesseract eng+fra+ara exceeded the 15-second initial recognition deadline. It has no OCR/semantic evidence; visual-only hybrid rank 4 falls to union 12 and hybrid50 11. Original page and competing documents were visually inspected. See explicit independent reproduction below.
failures.implemented: Existing bounded OCR failure isolation, visual fallback and explicit degraded status are preserved; no source-specific OCR or timeout tuning on the holdout.
failures.remaining: Investigate dense multilingual newspaper OCR separately with held-out OCR references; do not silently raise deadlines or claim transcription accuracy without references.

failures.diagnosis: The known positive is absent from all three top-50 channels. Full-channel ranks were recomputed with unchanged production encoders and compared with the English translations. OCR and originals were inspected; screenshots contain readable English OCR but Arabic matching does not recover these targets within the fixed budgets. A reranker cannot recover absent candidates.
failures.remaining: Improve Arabic candidate coverage and review plausible alternative positives; known-positive recall is not exhaustive retrieval accuracy.

failures.diagnosis: A UTF-8 published manifest was decoded with the platform default. The real collection raises UnicodeDecodeError under CP1252; other Arabic filenames decode into mojibake.
failures.implemented: load_manifest explicitly reads UTF-8. Regression publishes Arabic filename/OCR text and exercises lexical search with simulated CP1252 defaults.

ocr_reproduction.configuration: Unchanged production extract defaults; 30-second total budget, initial recognition cap 15 seconds.
